title: Windy Vault lease JWE known-answer vector (plan C7, V7.6 c2d)
description: TEST DATA ONLY: fixed test keys, no real secret. ECDH-ES+A256KW (X25519, RFC 8037 Concat KDF) + A256GCM compact JWE with a `kid` header naming the recipient lease key. Built by an independent Python implementation (cryptography) and decrypted by jwcrypto. A client (Windy Agent, Python jwcrypto) pins this: decrypting `expect_compact` with `recipient_pkcs8_b64` MUST yield `plaintext_utf8`; an unknown kid means re-lease. The TypeScript library reproduces `expect_compact` byte for byte from the fixed ephemeral key, CEK and IV. Frozen: any change is a new major file.
